title: ...freeze your credit reports against identity theft
desc: Block unauthorized loans and new credit accounts opened in your name.
todos: Create official security accounts on Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion portals.
Request a free Security Freeze on each of the 3 major credit bureau websites.
Store generated PINs or security passwords safely in a password manager.
Request a security freeze with Innovis and ChexSystems (checking account protection).
Unfreeze credit temporarily whenever applying for legitimate new loans or cards.
